meta.source: Built from the direction A2 mocks (fm-ui-a-polish: a2.css, report.md section 6, directions/A2/*.html) on 2026-11-20, with the Raised deck logo.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Window ground behind the floating panels and the status bar. Never put a control directly on it except title-bar items.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Floating panels, cards, inputs and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed fills inside a panel: segmented-control tracks, inner boxes, count badges, coverage cells.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Ghost hover fill for rows, tree items and icon buttons.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: NEW. Selected row, tree item or table row. Darker than hover so the two never look the same; always paired with the 3px ink bar.

tokens.name: toggle-on
tokens.usage: NEW. Fill of an icon button or toggle that is pressed or on: a solid white disc on the frame, no outline.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel borders, table rules, dividers.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Borders of controls that take input (note field, switches off). 3.4:1 on panel in light, 4.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: edge-soft
tokens.usage: Dashed end-of-list boxes, track of an off switch.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, selection bars, the on state of switches.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on any ground (6.0:1 on frame, 5.6:1 on selected).

tokens.name: muted-panel
tokens.usage: Quieter labels on white panels only (4.6:1). Fails on frame or sunken in light: use muted there. Was muted-p.

tokens.name: muted-strong
tokens.usage: Idle tab labels, keycap text, counts. Was muted2.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and nothing else. Solid black means an action.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered primary button.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and keycap on a primary button.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The navigation rail, in both themes.

tokens.name: rail-active
tokens.usage: Pill behind the selected rail item.

tokens.name: on-rail
tokens.usage: Selected and hovered rail label and icon.

tokens.name: on-rail-muted
tokens.usage: Idle rail label and icon (8.3:1 on rail).

tokens.name: brand-tile
tokens.usage: NEW. The Raised deck tile at the top of the rail.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: NEW. The ship mark inside the brand tile.

tokens.name: room
tokens.usage: The one teal room per window: Needs your call. Never a state, button, link, icon or text colour. Was teal.

tokens.name: on-room
tokens.usage: Text and keycaps inside the room (4.7:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Decision cards sitting inside the room.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Investigating state, low severity, info chips.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info chip fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Working state, green checks, audited coverage.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success chip fill, dot halo, zero-secrets tile.

tokens.name: success-mid
tokens.usage: Scanned-only coverage cells.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Waiting-on-you text, medium severity, needs-validation chips.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning chip fill and dot halo.

tokens.name: warning-dot
tokens.usage: Warning dot and medium severity square. Darkened from #c98a00 to reach 3:1 on white.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Blocked state, high severity, confirmed findings.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger chip fill and dot halo.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal ground.

tokens.name: term-line
tokens.usage: Terminal border.

tokens.name: term-ink
tokens.usage: Terminal text.

tokens.name: term-muted
tokens.usage: Prompts and paths in the terminal.

tokens.name: term-green
tokens.usage: Passed counts in the terminal.

tokens.name: term-amber
tokens.usage: Skipped counts and the cursor.

tokens.name: term-blue
tokens.usage: Agent narration bullets in the terminal.

tokens.name: tile-line
tokens.usage: Hairline inside project tiles so black and white tiles keep an edge.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: The council's lowest score. One per screen.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Inspector sections, decision-card titles, room heading.

styles.name: window-title
styles.usage: App name in the title bar.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Root cause found in the session fixture

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, table headers, status bar.

styles.name: rail-label
styles.usage: Labels under rail icons. The smallest text in the app.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between segments in a segmented control; rail items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to count, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dot to word, keycap to label.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Shell gutter between floating panels; default row gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap inside decision-card grid; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding (compact), title-bar side padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Inspector section vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel header and section side padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Space between groups inside a long panel.

tokens.name: radius-kbd
tokens.usage: Keycaps.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Project tiles and monograms.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Tree rows, list rows, the brand tile (40px).

tokens.name: radius-inner
tokens.usage: Inner boxes, terminal, decision cards, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Floating panels and the room.

tokens.name: radius-rail
tokens.usage: The rail (half its 68px width).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tabs, inputs, command bar, icon buttons.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on buttons, tabs, switches, rows and icon buttons. Text fields use focus-soft instead. Never removed without a replacement.

tokens.name: focus-soft
tokens.usage: Focus on text fields and the search field: an ink border plus this soft 3px halo.

tokens.name: panel-hi
tokens.usage: Tonal top edge on dark panels.

tokens.name: tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips and menus only.

tokens.name: size-titlebar
tokens.usage: Title bar height.

tokens.name: size-tabrow
tokens.usage: Tab row height.

tokens.name: size-status
tokens.usage: Status bar height.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Rail width.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Project list width.

tokens.name: size-inspector
tokens.usage: Inspector width.

tokens.name: size-project-row
tokens.usage: Project row in the tree.

tokens.name: size-worktree-row
tokens.usage: Worktree row in the tree.

tokens.name: size-table-head
tokens.usage: Table header row.

tokens.name: size-table-row
tokens.usage: Table body row.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Default button and command bar.

tokens.name: size-button-sm
tokens.usage: Small button inside cards.

tokens.name: size-tab
tokens.usage: Segment inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Status chip.

tokens.name: size-input
tokens.usage: Note field.

tokens.name: size-keycap
tokens.usage: Keycap.

tokens.name: size-rail-item
tokens.usage: Icon pill of a rail item (44 wide).

tokens.name: size-brand-tile
tokens.usage: Brand tile at the top of the rail.
